thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: Canary rollout 'fast-gen-v3' exceeded error-rate threshold in eu-west-1 (5m error_rate > 5%). Pager routed to eng-oncall. Link: https://alerts.redwood.internal/alert/1748539999
sarah: saw it on the dashboards — big jump in 95p latency + 5xx on /v1/generate
mike: I'm oncall, pulled traces. Error is java.io.IOException from grpc proxy, looks like stuck upstream connections
jordan: auto-rollback attempted but a bunch of canary pods are stuck Terminating, still serving connections (~120).
alisha: checked k8s: finalizers preventing drain, and NGINX upstream keepalive holding sockets open
mike: initiating manual rollback and flag flip. Command: `kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/fast-gen --to-revision=12`
sarah: also toggling feature flag `gen_fast_enable` -> false via ff-console (propagating) :arrow_down_small:
jordan: flag at 40% propagation, will force to 100% if needed
alisha: recommendation: use graceful drain script `/svc/drain --pod $POD --timeout 10m` not kill -9 unless we must
mike: starting force-evict on the 3 worst nodes to accelerate drain (doing in waves)
incident-bot: ROLLBACK_STARTED: fast-gen-v3 -> v2 by mike at 1748540200. Status: in-progress.
sarah: post-rollback metrics: error rate trending down 5% -> 1.1% in 5m window
jordan: running smoke check: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://eu-west.api.redwood/v1/health` -> 200 OK from 3 locations
alisha: connections count dropping, keepalive backlog cleared on the proxies
mike: note: one customer (acct: acme-inc) saw sustained 5xx for ~18m, opened a CS ticket. Low volume otherwise
customer-success: drafting a customer note and tagging acme-inc with timeline + mitigation. ETA 25m for short update
sarah: creating incident record and timeline now, please add timestamps for each action
mike: handing to overnight oncall @jordan for monitoring and verification. I'm available if it flares back
jordan: ack — I'll watch alerting, run smoke every 10m for next 2h, and validate traces. Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/rollback-canary
sarah: postmortem ping to postmortem-team and infra (probable kube finalizer bug causing slow drain). Add: improve auto-rollback drain checks
alisha: follow-up action: add a preflight to detect finalizers and abort auto-rollback if pods won't terminate cleanly
mike: thanks all. update thread with any customer responses or anomaly spikes. :thumbsup:
